title: 📧 A Breach Hits an Email Protection Service!
body: 📧 A Breach Hits an Email Protection Service!
N-able confirmed that attackers breached one of the servers of its cloud email-filtering service, forcing it to shut down dashboards and APIs in three regions around the world.
Email itself is still being delivered and filtered normally, and so far there is no evidence of customer data being stolen or access to their mailboxes.
Simply put, the management tools are temporarily down while the email works, and the company is gradually restoring the service after verifying its security.
Do you rely on an outside service to protect your email? And what is your backup if it stops?
